    Home
    The Problem

    The Problem

    NPH symptoms (gait disturbance, cognitive decline, urinary issues) can mimic Parkinson’s and other neurodegenerative disorders. Many patients go undetected, delaying a simple neurosurgical treatment that can restore independence and reduce long-term care costs.

    1 in 10 dementia cases

    May actually be NPH — a reversible cause

    Underdiagnosed

    Overlapping symptoms lead to missed referrals

    Treatable

    Shunt procedures can dramatically improve outcomes

    High system costs

    Late detection drives avoidable LTC expenditures

    Solution

    The Neurogait Solution

    A fast, smartphone-based gait screening test that uses computer vision to quantify spatiotemporal gait features and a validated machine-learning model to flag patterns consistent with NPH.

    Capture

    Record a 10-second, 3-meter walk towards the camera.

    Analyze
    Pose estimation extracts gait metrics; ML model generates a risk score.
    Report
    Get a structured result for triage and referral, exportable to the EHR.
